application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 3 (All External Materials) of planning permission ref: 25/01798/FUL as the details provided are insufficient to demonstrate that the development would incorporate appropriate external façade in accordance with the approved condition. In the absence of adequate information, the proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D1, D4 of the London Plan (2021), Polices DMD6 and DMD8 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/01798/FUL: external materials (3) in respect of demolition of existing garages and erection of 4x 4 bedroom dwellings with associated landscaping and vehicular access.
